Dialogs.Dialog: Since we're here, why don't we take a photo？
Let's take a picture, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ As a keepsake.
Sure？ What kind of shot today？
Want to take a commemorative photo, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Since we're here.
Sure, but... um, what should I do？
Make me look cute in my yukata, okay？
I'll play a trick on you？ Just kidding.
So we don't get in anyone's way, quickly... okay, pose！
Since we're here, get the nice scenery in too, okay？
Okay, instead of a pose... Merry Christmas♪
Take a pretty one, okay？ I'm all dressed up, after all.
Being with you on my birthday makes Manaka happy♪
Let's add anniversary photos one by one, okay？ From now on, forever.
I think we can take good photos during the excursion.
Okay, let's eat something. Which one？
Um... ah, that one looks good.
▲メニュー▲, huh. Then I'll take you up on it...
That was great！ Thanks for the treat, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hey, what do you want to eat？
When it comes to stalls, it's gotta be this！
Can I？ Then I'll help myself to some？
Mm, delicious♪ Thanks for the treat.
What else would it be？ Geez.
Um. Today, I made a bento...
I'm glad. I hope you like it...
It's full of love, so enjoy it... Just kidding.
Sorry for asking you out so suddenly？ There's something I really wanted to give you... Here.
A birthday present. I really wanted to give it to you on the day...
The day's already passed, but it's an anniversary present.
It's your Christmas gift. I'm sorry it's this late.
It was Valentine's Day, right？ It's already passed, but... will you accept it？
Thanks. Then here's something from me too...
Well, I'll head home？ Next year, I want to see you on the actual day.
You're right... I'm sorry. Really, thank you for this.
Um, this. A return gift for White Day.
...But I'm happy. Let's spend next year together.
(White Day's already passed, but maybe I can still do something...)
Sorry I couldn't give it to you on the day.
No, it's okay. Next year, let's spend it together？ Promise.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday already passed, but maybe I can still do something...)
It can't be helped this year, but... next year, I want to prepare properly and give it on the day.
Yeah, I'll look forward to it.
Yes. Then I'll go now. Bye-bye.
(She gave me chocolate even before we were dating... I'd better think of a White Day return gift.)
Next week is our anniversary, right？ Hey, want to do something？
Sounds good. But 'something'... what should we do？
Mm... To tell the truth？ I haven't thought of anything either.
Haha, I see. Then let's both think of something by the day before.
(I want to make it a great day！)
Remember we talked about doing something for our anniversary tomorrow？
Yeah, yeah. Come up with a good idea？
You know, I'd like to go shopping.
I thought it'd be nice to buy something to mark the occasion... What do you think？
Oh, nice, I'm in. How about tomorrow evening？
Hehe, I can't wait！ What should we buy？
Yeah. Actually, I predicted what you'd do, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...I was looking forward to it, that's why.
It's fine. I just came a little early...
I was so excited I came early, that's all, so don't worry？ Shall we go？
So... we're here, but what should we get？
Mm... it's hard to decide, huh？
Something matching we can both have would be good, right？
Yeah... ah, but since it's a keepsake, maybe something we don't use every day is better？
Glad we found a good one！
Mm. It took a lot of deciding, though. Does that count as a memory too...？
Hehe, that was fun, wasn't it？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, is there anything you'd really like？
Mm... I'd like something matching with you... what do you think？
Right, it's a keepsake... hmm, what would be good？
...Anything is fine with me. Even... this is extreme, but even a pencil or an eraser.
Something you and I picked out together like this... that alone would be enough.
▲高嶺＊＊▲... All right！ Let's look around a lot！
I'm glad we found a good one！
...I'll treasure it, okay？ The present, and today's memories too.
What kind would be good？ What should we get？
Let's see. Something matching that wouldn't be weird for the two of us to have...
We couldn't carry those around normally. Is that okay？
Ah... right？ That's good, but not so good...？
Haha, let's keep it as a candidate. We'll look around and then decide.
I'm glad we found something nice？
Yeah. Let's take good care of it.
We picked it together, so I'll treasure it forever▼
I hope we can keep adding things that are ours, like this.
Things we chose together... little by little.
Yeah... let's keep adding them. From now on too.
Ever since the day we first met... you've always treasured me, right？
So... I wanted to say it properly.
I see... Thank you too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. For treasuring me. Let's keep it up, okay？
Same here. Please take care of me.
Thank you for walking me home...
Be careful on your way home, okay？ Good night.
It was a wonderful anniversary, right？
We found something good, too. It was fun.
Me too... Hey, can I look forward to next year？
Well, this is where I leave you. See you？
Your birthday is next week, right？
...There's no way I'd forget, is there？
Hey, keep that day free, okay？
Are you doing something for me？
That's the plan. I haven't decided exactly what yet...
Got it. I'm looking forward to it！
Hey, about tomorrow... is it okay if I come to your place？
Eh！ Yeah, that's totally fine. I mean, you're more than welcome！
Good. I want to celebrate with everything I've got right now...
Huh？ Was I making a weird face？
Hehe！ Then wait at home tomorrow, okay？ Look forward to it♪
(I wonder what she'll do. I can't wait！)
Welcome！ So, what should I do？
Um... I'm going to cook, so wait over there？
Geez, that would defeat the point, right？ It's your birthday celebration.
If you don't listen, I won't make you anything.
Good. Just kidding. It won't take long, so be patient？
I'm the one who said to look forward to it, but...
If you stare like that, it's hard to cook...
I won't get in the way... so, no？
But don't watch me too much？ I might get nervous and mess up...
Good evening. Sorry, I was doing the prep and ran a little late.
I wanted to put my all into treating you.
Will you make something for me？ Here？
It's the wonderful day you were born, after all.
I want you to eat something delicious.
Hey, can I come in and borrow your kitchen？
A present？ Thanks, can I open it？
What is it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ So formal.
...Yes. I hope it suits your taste...
Good. Hearing you say that makes me happy too...
Hehe！ Here. Your birthday present. Happy birthday.
Oh... Thank you！ Can I open it？
I'm glad. Seeing you that happy makes me happy too.
Please use it with care？ Just kidding.
Hey. Did I do something that made you happy？
But that part of you... no, I love you, even like that.
You know？ There's one more thing... I want to give you. Will you accept it？
...No. If I stay any longer, I won't want to go home.
For being born... for meeting me, for being by my side.
It's your birthday, but... is it okay for me to be this happy？
...I ended up being the happy one after all.
Well, I'm happy too. Actually, I think I'm happier？
...It's a little early, but maybe I'll book next year too.
If you want, you can make it a permanent reservation？
......Then, can I have proof of that？
Happy birthday. I hope it's a good year for you. Bye？
Thank you for remembering. I'm happy. ...Hehe！
When I was little？ A friend suddenly gave me a present once. Saying, "Happy birthday."
I was really happy, but... I didn't know what to do. It was March.
My friend looked so happy that I couldn't say anything and just took it...
If we ever meet again, I have to set it straight. ...Hehe, I'll never forget that.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Is there anywhere you'd like to go on your birthday？
Anywhere, as long as it's with you...
Make the reservation, okay？ Just kidding.
So are you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Anyway, let's talk as we walk.
Wow, that surprised me. I thought I'd left pretty early.
I couldn't settle down at home... so I left early.
I see... good thing I left early too！
Good thing you came early. Just kidding. Hehe！
We've arrived！ Now then, Miss Takane. Allow me to show you to your reserved seat. This way.
Thank you... just kidding. I'm glad our usual bench was free.
I half thought about taping a 'Reserved' sign on it, actually.
A sign like that would surprise people, right？ "Reserved for what？" they'd say.
I kind of wanted to see that. Hehehe！
Still... are you really fine with a place like this？ A fancy restaurant would've been fine too.
Hmm？ Then shall we go to one now？
Ahh... that's, you know！ Reservations and stuff are kind of... right？
Anywhere is fine, as long as you're with me and we can relax together.
More importantly, look. Look, look？ It's sparkling. So pretty.
(Maybe this is what they call happiness...)
I see, good. That's a relief.
Sorry. Because I asked for Fountain Park...
It's fine, it's fine. I worried about it too much too. Sorry, okay？
No. I was happy with it too, so don't worry about it.
You were with me today. That alone is enough.
Um, say... Did you have fun？
Of course. So much. It was fun... and I'm feeling happy right now too？
I got to have you all to myself. If I asked for more than this...
I don't know what would happen to me...
You brought me to the place I wanted to go, so why？
Then, shall I be even more spoiled on the way home？
Yeah！ Go right ahead！ Come on！
Hehe, stop it. Why are you suddenly so energetic？ Geez.
Yeah. I hope you like it.
Oh right. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, this... a present.
Ah. I'm so happy, you got me something... Thank you！
You're really amazing, you know？ I'll treasure it...
...Lovely. I love this kind of thing... Thank you. I'll treasure it, okay？
What are you going to do, making me this happy？ Thank you, I'll treasure it.
Thank you. I like this kind of thing, you know？ I'll take good care of it, okay？
Thank you, I'm so happy... I'll take good care of it, okay？
A present like this makes me happy. Thank you.
...Mm, thank you. Um... I'll take good care of it, okay？
Thank you. I made you go to some trouble, huh... I'm sorry.
...You getting me something is enough. Thank you.
Hey. Next year, will you tape up the reserved sign？
Eh！ ...How about 'I'll see what I can do'？
Then before that, maybe I'll make a reservation for you alone？
...Okay. I'm counting on you. Just kidding.
Well then, this is where I leave you. Thank you, it was fun.
Thank you so much for today. Spending it with you... made me happy.
I... I think right now I'm the happiest girl in the world.
...Good night. I hope I can see you in my dreams too.
Thank you for today. It was fun. But...
Next year, and every year after.
I'm leaving the planning of my birthdays to you. Forever. Just kidding.
Well then, this is where I leave you. Thank you for today. Good night.
Tanabata's next week. I hope the night is clear.
Right... there are lots of rainy or cloudy days. It's right in the rainy season.
I wonder if the gods chose that time on purpose. To make it more moving when they finally meet, or something.
Really. Maybe I'll make teru teru bozu to cheer the two of them on.
Nice. Plus, with our lovey-dovey power, we'll make it clear for sure！
Agreed. Hey, why don't we each bring a wish strip？
Oh, with our wishes written on them beforehand？
Yeah. Well, I figured it would.
Hehe！ Maybe it's thanks to our lovey-dovey power and the teru teru bozu.
Ah, that's right. Did you bring your wish strip？
I see. Then I'll change it to a different wish――
Haha. Kidding, kidding, just a joke！
......Hey, your wish... is this really it？
Of course！ Let's hang them up quick！
Then let's write it here, okay？ Here.
I wonder if they're having a happy time together right now... Orihime and Hikoboshi.
I bet a shaved ice they're having a time just as happy as ours.
...I just think... I'd hate to lose to them.
...I hope it's clear again next year too？
Yeah... let's make it clear. With our――
That's right. And don't forget the teru teru bozu.
Hey, did you know there's a festival at Towano Shrine next month？
I think I heard... Sounds nice, let's go.
...I just remembered a legend that's been bothering me.
A legend that if a couple goes to the festival, the god gets jealous and they end up breaking up.
So there's a legend like that... Well, it'll be fine. A crisis like that could never happen to us！
...Right？ Mm, I'll try not to worry about it. Yeah.
By the way. That Towano Festival you told me about, do you know when it starts？
It seems it started today. And it runs until the last Sunday of August.
I see. It runs a pretty long time. I hope we can go a few times while it's on.
...▲高嶺＊＊▲, you don't really feel like going？
Somehow, you seem a bit down...
...The legend is kind of... But I'm fine？ Don't worry？
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Yeah, a yukata's great. It suits you. Yeah.
Thank you. ...Geez, don't stare so much. Shall we go？
It really was. Ah, ring toss.
...Ah, wait. Actually, the string lottery. I'd like the candy ring？
Yes, you. Win it for me▼
(All right, I'll pull with everything I've got！)
By the way, it seems there'll be fireworks at the end of the festival's last day.
Huh, really？ Then we can't miss that.
I was wondering if you're not worried about the legend anymore...
There were people close to me who proved it wrong. So.
Let's have as much fun as we can.
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Are you okay？ It's crowded.
My obi's bothering me a little... but otherwise I'm fine.
I see, good. ...Yeah, the yukata's great. Yukata are great！
Hehe, geez. Thank you. Shall we go？
The festival and summer are both coming to an end.
But I like that feeling too. It's a strange feeling.
What did you wish for, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I wished that the legend would become a happy one for couples too.
...I see. Maybe I should've wished for that too.
Hehe, it's fine. I wished plenty for your share too.
We're done praying, so let's relax？ I want some anzu-ame.
By the way. Those people close to you who proved the legend wrong...
They've prayed and gone on dates here together lots of times, and they're doing great, you know？ That's what Mama told me.
"The god of love is enshrined there, so it makes no sense that couples who go would break up！" she said.
Right？ I think it's just been misunderstood.
Maybe someone went through something painful enough that they wanted to blame the god... Ah.
...Let's come again？ To report that we're happy.
Next year too, like this... let's watch it together...
By the way, there's a fireworks show next week, right？
Looks like it. Shall we go？
But it's going to be very crowded...
Hmm, we might need to brace ourselves a bit...
She should be here soon... Ah. ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Good, I found you right away. Ah, sorry to keep you waiting.
It's fine, it's fine. You're in a yukata, so of course it takes time to get ready.
Thank you. Um, what do we do now？
Let's see... we have time, so let's check out the stalls.
Okay, it's about time, so let's get going.
Seriously. We have to make sure we don't get separated. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, this way.
It's over... I wish I could've watched a bit more slowly.
Yeah... let's head home early. The trains will be packed.
The most hidden of hidden spots, right？ I wanted to watch it with you in peace, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...You searched for it. Thank you, I'm so happy...
Yeah. Oh, it's about to start.
Beautiful... Watching them this close feels like such a luxury.
Hearing you say that makes me happy too. Oh, here comes a big one！
Amazing. I want to keep watching forever... with you, just us two...
Yeah. It was over so fast... Okay, let's head home. We can take a slow walk.
It'd be so nice if you could see fireworks from home.
Oh, that'd be nice. You could easily see them from a high-rise apartment.
...Will you keep that in mind, too？
I will！ Wait, keep what in mind？
Thank you for today. It was so wonderful... and fun.
Let's go again next year, okay？ Well then... good night.
Sports day is almost here, huh？
Yeah. Did you decide on your event？
I'm in the scavenger race. And you？
I see... I'm a little worried.
I'll practice properly, so I'll be fine.
...Really？ Be careful not to get hurt during practice either, okay？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. How's your practice for sports day going？
▲主人公＊▲. I'm practicing. Though it's mostly just running.
No good！ You have to practice the scavenger part.
You don't know what you'll draw, right？ Like glasses！ Or a towel！
You mean figure out in advance where to borrow things from？
Exactly. Okay, here goes？ Your type of guy！
Geez, this isn't practice at all. Hehehe！
(The rehearsal is kind of a pain...)
Good work. ...You look like you're thinking it's a pain.
If you don't take it seriously and tomorrow goes badly, don't blame me.
We will now begin the Towano High School Sports Festival.
(The scavenger race ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s in is... oh, it's pretty soon.)
(Okay, I have to go cheer for her！)
▲主人公＊▲. Did you come to cheer for me？
I'm fine. Seeing your face made my heart race a little, though.
So it backfired... Then I'll just go...
Sorry, I was lying. ...Thank you. Actually, I was a little nervous.
But I'm fine now. I'll take first place, so... watch me？
As expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you left them in the dust！
Thank you. Maybe it was thanks to practicing with you？
...I never thought there'd actually be 'lovey-dovey person' in there, though.
Hehe！ Thanks to you, I got first place♪
Now it's your cavalry battle, right？ Go for it▼
Next is the morning's final event, the second-year boys' cavalry battle.
It's fine, it's fine！ I was just a little nervous！
I see... then, a good luck charm.
(I'm all fired up！ Let's do this！)
Don't stop, charge all at once！
Congrats！ You were a star out there？
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s charm worked. I hope I looked a little cool.
...Just kidding. Hey, let's have lunch？ I put my all into making it.
Sorry？ You cheered for me and all... How uncool...
That's not true. I know how hard you tried.
Hey, let's eat lunch to get ready for the afternoon？ You can't fight on an empty stomach！ Right？
The final event of the sports festival is a folk dance with all grades participating.
(A folk dance, huh. I wonder if I'll get to dance with ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Likewise. Please take care of me.
...This kind of thing makes me nervous...
Yeah. Ah, sorry in advance if I step on your foot？
...I wish the music would just stop like this.
I'd stop it. Or we could run away from this circle.
...If you'll carry me off, okay？ Just kidding.
This concludes the sports festival program. Thank you all for your hard work.
Phew. You'll sleep soundly tonight, huh？
So that means ▲高嶺＊＊▲ sleeps like that every night...
Geez. The sports festival was fun, wasn't it？
Hey, did you hear about the Halloween party？
Yeah. Sounds kind of fun, right？
I want to！ Or rather, I want to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s costume！
...You want to see it that much？
...Then maybe I'll join？ Ah, of course, I wouldn't do it if you weren't there, okay？
Hey, I wanted to ask you something about Halloween...
What kind of costume should I wear？
(I wonder what she'll come as... Can't wait！)
Ooh！ So you went with that.
...Hey, is it really okay to go to school dressed like this？ Really...
Costumes aren't scary if we walk together！ That's how it goes, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Well, that's fine, but the problem is I don't want other guys seeing you...
Nothing. Shall we go？ We'll be late.
Everyone's dressed up in all sorts of ways, huh？
Blending in with all this, we're no big deal either.
Hehe, maybe. Ah, everyone in the tennis club complimented me so much.
Yes. ...They complimented you too, I think？ Especially the girls.
Aw. Yeah, well, figures, me getting compliments.
School at night is pretty creepy... Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Hehe. Then maybe I'll play a trick on you...？ Tickle tickle！
Hehe, I won't stop▼ Tickle tickle！
(The kids playing ghosts probably think we're flirting... but who cares！)
Did you hear the tennis club decided on its school festival booth？
I see. That might be good, it's easy. It'd taste the same no matter who made it.
...If we're making it, I want to serve something delicious.
Sounds fun. Maybe I'll suggest it to everyone？
Hmm. What's missing？ We're almost out of time, too...
All right, let's keep at it until the last minute. I'll stick with you！
Everyone said it was delicious too... I'm glad.
Well, this is a memory too.
Okay. Well then, shall we go help the setup team！
Haah... We barely made it in time.
...Yes. I'm sleepy, but... I'm fine. Um... gym shoes, one dozen... was it？
First, let's grab something to eat！
Agreed♪ I wonder what kinds of booths there are. I can't wait.
Okay, next... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, anywhere you want to see？
Ah, yes. I'd like to go to the confectionery club, is that okay？
How was it？ From the ▲高嶺＊＊▲ point of view.
That was educational. I want to try making some next time.
I see. ...Ever think about quitting tennis and joining the confectionery club？
Hmm... if you join. Just kidding.
(If ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s in it, then me too... Just kidding！)
We still have time, so let's look around a bit more.
This is... the photography club. What's this？
I don't really get it... okay, let's go see.
Welcome, welcome to the Photography Club！
Okay, go ahead and pick one！
Okay！ Then your girlfriend changes over here！
You wait here holding the camera！
Thank you very much！ Come again！
...It feels like we just got swept along, but it was a nice memento... I think？
Okay, time to head back. We need to get ready for the afternoon.
The afternoon is the main event, so let's do our best？
Announcement. All tennis club members, please report to the club room immediately. Repeating――
Maybe... let's go. Too bad, I thought we'd get to look around a bit more.
Don't worry, it can't be helped.
...Phew. No time to rest, huh？ And more customers keep coming...
That just means the yakisoba ▲高嶺＊＊▲ supervised is that good.
Geez. Flattering me won't get you anything――
I had a moment free, so a taste test. You haven't eaten much, right？ Say "ahh"？
(I missed out on both the 'ahh' and the yakisoba... Darn captain...)
Yeah, there are fireworks on the field, right？
You know. I was wondering if we could watch from the classroom.
Sure, but... is that okay？ Not joining in？
It's okay. I want to relax with you, just the two of us...
Hehe. Everyone looks like they're having fun.
It's already been a year since then... It went by so fast.
The clothes you gave me last year made me so happy...
The cosmetics you gave me last year made me so happy...
The accessory you gave me last year made me so happy...
Even if it's just flattery, I'm glad.
It's not flattery. It really was a wonderful gift, you know？
(When she's this happy, it makes giving gifts worth it.)
Don't you feel like this mood starts earlier every year？
Yeah, yeah. Waiting until December is probably too late. For all sorts of things.
Hey, what do we do if it keeps getting earlier and earlier？
Like, Christmas mood starts as soon as summer break ends？
Hehehe！ It feels like that might really happen someday, right？
We'll have to keep checking, the two of us.
Hey, did you hear there's going to be an event at school on Christmas Eve？
...No fair, saying it before I could.
Haha！ I wanted to be the one to ask, you know.
Oh, and since it's a special day. How about a date before that too？
...Then I'll let you invite me to that too. It's a special day, after all？
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Wow, the illuminations. They really went all out.
If it snowed, it would be even more perfect.
Mm... snow's not happening, but look.
The stars are already out... So pretty. They're not losing to the lights...
Hey, we still have time, right？ I want to ride the merry-go-round.
We'd better get moving soon, or we'll be late.
Time flies, huh. Okay, let's go.
Phew, made it！ They really went all out here too.
...I like the mood at the amusement park, but this kind of thing is nice too, right？
Yeah. The handmade feel gives it a nice touch.
Sorry, can I go over there for a bit？
Sorry, borrowing Takane for a bit！
Ah, geez！ Wait for me, okay？
Yo, looks like your girlfriend ditched you.
You jerk！ I don't have one, idiot！
I'll get one right now, so just wait！
Sorry to keep you waiting. You know, it seems we need to pick something up over there.
We'll be holding a bingo game later, so please pick a card.
Here you go. Please hold on to it.
And now, the moment you've all been waiting for, the bingo game begins！
Yes！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, bingo！ You got bingo！
The prize is ▲アイテム名▲, huh. Nice going, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Haah, I got a little excited.
Haha. All right, I'm gonna win too！
And that concludes the bingo game！ Thank you all！
Okay. Shall we head home？ I'll walk you.
...Hey, why don't we take a detour and see the tree before going home？
Oh, right. Yeah, it's Christmas Eve after all. Let's do that.
Being in a place like this at this hour... feels so strange.
I'm fine. Santa may have cast some magic on me.
So that I can see a wonderful view with you...
Ah, me too！ Want to swap on the count of three？
You know？ I have a present...
Oh, thanks！ I brought one too, so let's swap.
Yeah. This one's from me. Here！
Hey, did you happen to bring a present today？
I did！ Which means you did too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I thought it would be nice if we could exchange them.
Sounds good. Then let's hand them over on three.
Thank you for a present that'll make an unforgettable memory. I'll treasure it, okay？
Wow... Thank you. I really like this kind of thing... I'll cherish it.
...Thank you！ Even if I can't stop smiling after this, don't hate me, okay？
So there are things like this too. Thank you.
...Thank you, I'll take good care of it, okay？
This kind of thing might be nice. Thank you.
A present？ You mean, like Santa Claus？
(Oops, maybe I should've gotten her a present.)
▲主人公＊▲, you know？ I have a present...
Ah... no, sorry...！ Don't worry about it？
(Oops... maybe I should've gotten her a present.)
...Never mind. ...Maybe I should've told you beforehand.
(Oops！ Should I have gotten her a present？)
Do you know the Winter Diamond？
Yes. If you connect six stars into a hexagon, it makes a diamond shape.
It's what diamonds stand for. I thought it fit how I feel today.
...Merry Christmas. Next year too, I'll never forget this feeling.
